summary: Verified and corrected the missing qualified lm_head prefix in BailingMoELinearForCausalLM. The broader audit still finds 52 other sites, so this is a narrow candidate rather than a claim that the full source issue is solved.

tests.command: pre-fix constructor probe for BailingMoELinearForCausalLM with prefix='language_model'

10 compressed-tensors lm_head tests passed, including 2 new Bailing prefix subtests for root and nested prefixes.
The corrected Bailing site is absent; 52 other quantization-aware constructor sites still omit an explicit prefix.
All changed Python sources compile successfully.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect is CPU-only constructor/configuration name routing and occurs before model weights or GPU kernels execute.

remaining_limitations: No Bailing model weights were available, so no full-model semantic or serving reproduction was attempted.
The retained audit reports 52 additional omitted-prefix sites that need independent model-specific validation.

No GPU numerical check was performed because this patch does not alter numerical computation or GPU code.
